rest.description: Enable REST API endpoints and configure request handling.

preconditions.description: Handle HTTP request preconditions. Set false for applications that implement their own conditional request handling.

preconditionLocks.description: Acquire default-scope record locks for conditional single-record PUT, PATCH and DELETE on RocksDB before evaluating the precondition once against the locked record: one winner among conditional requests, cluster-wide when cluster record locks are available and node-local on core-only; on harper-pro without replication.recordLocks enabled, conditional writes fail with 503. Unconditional writes are not gated and still resolve last-write-wins. Set false to opt out into a best-effort single pre-check without locking (also used on LMDB, which has no record lock). Preconditions are never re-evaluated on commit retries.

lastModified.description: Include Last-Modified response headers for versioned records.

files.description: Glob(s) or path(s) to GraphQL schema files.
Glob(s) or path(s) to the files to serve.

urlPath.description: URL path prefix the files are served under.

index.description: Serve index.html files for directory requests.

extensions.description: File extensions to try appending when a requested path is not found (e.g. ['html'] serves /page.html for /page).

fallthrough.description: Pass unmatched requests to the next handler. When false, this handler answers unmatched GETs itself — note it runs before the REST handler by default, so also set `after: 'rest'` if the application serves an API.

notFound.description: File to serve when a path is not found (requires `fallthrough: false`). Either a path, or an object with `file` and `statusCode` (e.g. index.html with 200 for history-mode SPAs — combine with `after: 'rest'`).

before.description: Run this handler before the named handler (the config key as registered, e.g. 'rest'). Defaults to 'authentication' so file requests skip credential parsing; false clears the default so registration order applies.

after.description: Run this handler after the named handler (the config key as registered, e.g. 'rest' to let API routes match before static fallbacks). Overrides the default `before: 'authentication'` hoist.

scheduler.description: Recurring job scheduling. Jobs run once per cluster (leader-elected) and invoke a designated export from this component. Handlers should be idempotent: leadership failover and DST fall-back can occasionally deliver the same occurrence twice.

jobs.description: The jobs to run on a schedule.

name.description: Unique (within this component) name for the job.

cron.description: Five-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), e.g. '0 2 * * *'. Supports lists, ranges, steps, month/day names, and @daily-style macros. Always QUOTE the expression: YAML treats a leading '*' as an alias and '@' as reserved. Exactly one of cron or interval is required.

interval.description: Simple cadence instead of cron: a duration like 90s, 5m, 1h, 1d (or a number of seconds). Between 1 second and 365 days.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the cron expression is evaluated in (e.g. America/New_York). Defaults to the server timezone. Only valid with cron.

handler.description: Module path and named export to invoke, relative to the component directory: './jobs.ts#myExport' (omit '#...' to use the default export). Do not put a space before '#' — YAML would treat the rest as a comment.

package.description: Package identifier for the application (npm-compatible or git URL).

studio.description: What this component adds to Harper Studio for the cluster it is deployed to, returned to every authenticated role by get_studio_configuration. An invalid page is dropped with a logged warning; the component still loads.

id.description: Unique within the component; Studio addresses the page as <component>.<id>.

placement.description: tab: a top Studio tab; config: an entry in the Config page menu.

access.description: Who Studio shows the page to, evaluated by Studio against the viewer's role. Not a server permission.

content.description: The page's content, rendered and validated by Studio.
